diagnostics: Initial new fixture attempted a zero-quantity bag removal; corrected independently from production. Native Abomasnow/Tyranitar already start weather, so their controls explicitly clear old weather before declarations.

Actual suppressed player hits exposed raw-ability consumers in move conversion/base power, residual/weather and metadata Levitate. These now read existing EffectContext policy, including defensive bypass where applicable.

Trace used raw-object membership/global choice/direct assignment. It now uses executable eligible living foes/notrace flags, private RNG, proper state/handlers/one Start; Mega reentry restores its own trait and ordinary startup, reconstruction does not replay it.

Healer now uses private RNG and living active allies. Prankster now adds full +1 with a marked used-copy opposing Dark status immunity. Shadow Tag voluntary switches query the active effective owner and escape controls rather than an absent tryTrap method/sticky owner flag.
Nonqualifying Body Slam exposed Technician reading absent move.base_power default zero. Qualification now uses actual positive hook power <=60, with 60/61 and suppression controls.

Parental Bond now has two separately applied hits for its documented ordinary class: .25 formula second hit, normal fixed damage, per-hit contact/substitute/secondary, one source PP and one after-move phase. Unsupported custom/charged/spread/recoil classes retain ordinary behavior and receive no extra hit.

Exploratory test assumptions were corrected: fixed-damage Seismic Toss is eligible; empty weather may be None; connected battle objects are not deepcopy fixtures; doubles require an explicit actor; Breloom Effect Spore may poison contact attackers, so sleep immunity uses a noncontact source; an ordinary Hurricane control uses a known private miss seed rather than assuming numeric stages affect this consumer. Failed diagnostic runs are not acceptance.

The first frozen candidate passed 557 PostgreSQL/440 focused checks but mandatory combined found one legacy callback-binding assertion still expecting fractional Prankster .1. Updated it to require full +1 and its used-copy marker, added that node to focused checks and reran the fresh qualification. Production rules were not weakened to retain the obsolete expectation.
limits: Local production command/menu/engine/SQL acceptance with captured transport, not socket login, released live acceptance, CI/merge or deployed stock.
No PF2-Dev edits, migrations, reloads, human data, service operations or running-world source installation. All test schemas/public tables empty; task-owned empty cluster retained for Z tests.
Only 47 explicit native stone pairs. CAP, Rayquaza required-move, Ultra, AI and new battle formats excluded. Plot-only keys/rings/quests excluded.
Existing Venusaurite-only Counter receipts reject recipe drift without adding/resetting stock. A current-world source update needs separate reviewed operation.

Parental Bond excludes status/existing-multihit/spread/Struggle/charge/recharge/future/Z/Max/OHKO/recoil/drain/self-switch/self-destruct/custom Hit/AfterHit/damage-callback classes from its extra hit. Eligible ordinary fixed damage stays fixed on both hits.
Historical design JSON and prior dated reports remain original snapshots; current Markdown and explicit runtime map record this qualified expansion.

primary_review.use: Review of full Prankster priority, Trace exclusion/initialization and Parental Bond eligibility; local PF2 content and published bounded rules remain authoritative.
